answer: An agent marketplace can anchor each account's bidding quota to tokens locked in escrow for a 30-day horizon: one locked token buys one bid per day, and splitting a deposit across accounts never increases the total quota. An attacker can grow a vine of fake identities, but gaining 10,000 extra daily bids still requires locking 10,000 extra tokens for a month, tying up capital and forfeiting its use elsewhere.
